Hi Lauren —

Thanks again for speaking with us yesterday. Attached is the take-home packet for the Senior Inference Engineer role. A few quick notes: 

- Deadline: Monday, Nov 23 at 11:59pm PT (10 calendar days).
- Deliverables: README, short design write-up (max 2 pages), working repo with instructions, and a short recording (optional).
- Data: data_sample.csv is provided to keep things reproducible.

Please reply to confirm you received the materials and whether the deadline works for you. If you need extra time for a specific reason, let me know and we'll discuss.

I'll also be lining up reviewers and will send the reviewer schedule once confirmed.

Good luck — happy to answer any clarifying Qs.

Best,
